title: The Unassigned row behaves like a rep row — count, expandable, in the Totals — and never carries an (Inactive) tag
preconditions: 1. Show Unassigned is on with a populated Unassigned row.
steps: 1. Read the Unassigned row's columns and (N) count.
expected: 1. The Unassigned row shows the same metric columns and the (N) count like any rep summary row.
2. It is expandable to its contributing invoices.
3. It is included in the grand Totals indicator.
